shadow_options.rule: options (live on the card): box · Playbook home run · Tulip v3.2 · turn entry · sniper · calls checkpoint. Card's latest side = direction; agreeing signals as fired; signals against it flipped to the card's side (card's ladder); before the card's first buy only the box; none after the card's 2nd stop; box + Playbook 2 contracts unless flipped.

shadow_hiv.rule: high-IV layer: POP PUT (after 6:50, QQQ $1.50+ over VWAP and +$1.50 in 15 min, IV over 35% at that minute; 25% stop, sell within 40 min) + BELL PUT (6:00->open down 0.15%+ after a red night, IV over 35% at 6:31; 1 contract, 25% stop, breakeven after +50%, hold to 8:56). Skips a pop while the bot holds a call.
shadow_hiv.lean: puts — green night, premarket sold off

shadow_bigfish.rule: gap vs week (queue #7a): last week down + open $2.50+ above yesterday's close → calls, same entry/exit (big fish wins if both). big fish: setup = (20-day return −8% or worse OR 5-day −3% or worse OR QQQ 20-day vol 26%+) AND gap 1%+; 6:35 close on the gap's side of the open; buy the ~$1.00 0DTE at 6:36 (no IV rule); out on the first 1-min close back across VWAP from 6:40, −35% stop, else 8:56. Skipped if the bell put holds the same side.

shadow_v10.rule: v10 auction layer (paper): ORB = first close outside 6:30–6:45 · EXT = level break that makes a new day high/low once 40–100% of the implied move is used · POP (GARCH > 22%) = 15% of the 10-day range in 3 min with the 20-min candle · never against the last 3-min move · delta 0.35, ask 0.40–3.00 · 25% stop, +$0.30 → 3-min trail, 60 min max · baseline = random entries, same exits

shadow_v11.rule: v11 = v10 + master switch: last evening's VIX change < −3.5% (vol release) or ≥ +2.5% with GARCH ≥ 22 (fast vol bid) → follow the opening-range break; otherwise (vol stall / calm vol bid) → don't chase it, buy the other way if it closes back inside within 10 min

shadow_vol.rule: volume layer (paper): GAP BREAK = 1-min close $0.25 through one of the bot's weekly thin gaps → buy the break · NODE BOUNCE = touch a volume node / POC, then 30% of R back within 10 min → buy the bounce · max 2 each a morning, not when v11 already bought that side within 10 min · v11 contract + exits

shadow_duo.rule: COMBO (paper): old bot (v9.2 card) + new bot (v11) + volume layer (gap breaks / confirmed node bounces, since Nov 22) every morning, opposite sides allowed · when a trade first gets to +$0.30: ADD +1 same contract and a LOTTO (cheapest same side asking $0.30–0.80), both sold with the main trade · self-check: a bot sits out when its last 10 active mornings make less per trade than random entries
